svg.text: hole: grown-up pokes with a pencil/awl
Calibration: the black bar must measure
exactly 100 mm and the square 20x20 mm.
Use card ~1 mm (cereal box) for parts.
github.com/dev-repos/kids-robotics-projects · Kids.JoinDev · CC BY 4.0 · Grown-ups do all craft-knife cutting.
3 mm corrugated cardboard. Hip plates hold the TT motor upright in the hips; one crank on each shaft end.
same shape - glue it flipped over (mirror)
Hip hole: 36 mm behind and 8 mm below the shaft (keep exact - this sets the walk).
Glue the two A discs into one 6 mm crank, and the two B discs into another.
Centre: D-hole Ø5.4 with flat (3.7 across) - snug on the TT shaft, then a drop of hot glue.
A: flat on the lobe side. B: flat away from lobe. On the same shaft the flats line up,
so A and B pins point OPPOSITE ways = 180° apart = left, right, left, right!
Crank pin Ø3 at 8 mm; the lobe keeps 3 mm of card round the pin hole.
TT gear motor (double shaft): body ~70 x 22 x 18 mm, 5.4 mm D-shaft out both sides (~9 mm each).
Check yours: the Ø30 hole goes round the shaft, the dashed box shows where the body sits.
